f3_program: collection("cole.backyard.fence.sides", "fence_side", "cole.backyard", source("fence his backyard on three sides"))
observe(at("cole.backyard.fence.sides.count", "planned"), 3, "count", source("three sides"))
observe(at("cole.backyard.left_side.length", "current"), 9, "foot", source("9 feet along the sides"))
observe(at("cole.backyard.right_side.length", "current"), 9, "foot", source("9 feet along the sides"))
observe(at("cole.backyard.back_side.length", "current"), 18, "foot", source("18 feet along the back"))
observe(at("fencing.cost_per_foot", "current"), 3, "dollar_per_foot", source("Fencing costs $3 per foot"))
rate_relation(at("cole.backyard.fence.left_side.cost", "planned"), at("fencing.cost_per_foot", "current"), at("cole.backyard.left_side.length", "current"), source("Fencing costs $3 per foot"))
rate_relation(at("cole.backyard.fence.right_side.cost", "planned"), at("fencing.cost_per_foot", "current"), at("cole.backyard.right_side.length", "current"), source("Fencing costs $3 per foot"))
rate_relation(at("cole.backyard.fence.back_side.cost", "planned"), at("fencing.cost_per_foot", "current"), at("cole.backyard.back_side.length", "current"), source("Fencing costs $3 per foot"))

sum_relation(at("cole.backyard.fence.total_cost", "planned"), at("cole.backyard.fence.left_side.cost", "planned"), at("cole.backyard.fence.right_side.cost", "planned"), at("cole.backyard.fence.back_side.cost", "planned"), source("fence his backyard on three sides"))

fraction_of(at("cole.neighbor.behind.fence_payment", "planned"), at("cole.backyard.fence.back_side.cost", "planned"), 1, 2, source("The neighbor behind him agreed to pay for half of their shared side of his fence"))

fraction_of(at("cole.neighbor.left.fence_payment", "planned"), at("cole.backyard.fence.left_side.cost", "planned"), 1, 3, source("the neighbor on his left agreed to pay for a third of their shared side"))

sum_relation(at("cole.neighbors.fence_payment", "planned"), at("cole.neighbor.behind.fence_payment", "planned"), at("cole.neighbor.left.fence_payment", "planned"), source("The neighbor behind him agreed to pay for half of their shared side of his fence, and the neighbor on his left agreed to pay for a third of their shared side"))

difference_relation(at("cole.backyard.fence.payment", "planned"), at("cole.backyard.fence.total_cost", "planned"), at("cole.neighbors.fence_payment", "planned"), source("How much does Cole have to pay for the fence?"))
query("value", at("cole.backyard.fence.payment", "planned"))
assumptions: Cole's payment is the total three-side fence cost minus the two neighbors' stated contributions.

f3_program: collection("lucille.mother.garden.weeds", "weed", "lucille.mother.garden", source("every weed she pulled in her mom's garden"))
observe(at("lucille.weeding.earnings_rate", "current"), 6, "cent_per_weed", source("six cents for every weed she pulled"))
observe(at("lucille.mother.garden.flower_bed.weeds.count", "initial"), 11, "count", source("eleven weeds in the flower bed"))
observe(at("lucille.mother.garden.vegetable_patch.weeds.count", "initial"), 14, "count", source("fourteen in the vegetable patch"))
observe(at("lucille.mother.garden.fruit_tree_grass.weeds.count", "initial"), 32, "count", source("thirty-two in the grass around the fruit trees"))

remove("weed_flower_bed", "lucille", at("lucille.mother.garden.flower_bed.weeds.count", "current"), at("lucille.mother.garden.flower_bed.weeds.count", "initial"), source("Lucille weeded the flower bed, the vegetable patch, and half the grass"))

remove("weed_vegetable_patch", "lucille", at("lucille.mother.garden.vegetable_patch.weeds.count", "current"), at("lucille.mother.garden.vegetable_patch.weeds.count", "initial"), source("Lucille weeded the flower bed, the vegetable patch, and half the grass"))

remove("weed_fruit_tree_grass", "lucille", at("lucille.mother.garden.fruit_tree_grass.weeds.count", "current"), fraction(at("lucille.mother.garden.fruit_tree_grass.weeds.count", "initial"), 1, 2), source("Lucille weeded the flower bed, the vegetable patch, and half the grass"))

sum_relation(at("lucille.weeds_pulled.count", "before_break"), event_field("weed_flower_bed", "quantity"), event_field("weed_vegetable_patch", "quantity"), event_field("weed_fruit_tree_grass", "quantity"), source("Lucille weeded the flower bed, the vegetable patch, and half the grass"))

rate_relation(at("lucille.weeding.earnings.cents", "before_break"), at("lucille.weeding.earnings_rate", "current"), at("lucille.weeds_pulled.count", "before_break"), source("she would earn six cents for every weed she pulled in her mom's garden"))

produce("weeding_earnings", "lucille", at("lucille.earnings.cents", "current"), at("lucille.weeding.earnings.cents", "before_break"), source("she would earn six cents for every weed she pulled in her mom's garden"))
remove("soda_purchase", "lucille", at("lucille.earnings.cents", "current"), 99, source("She bought a soda for 99 cents on her break with some of her earnings"))
query("value", at("lucille.earnings.cents", "current"))
assumptions: The phrase "half the grass" denotes half of the weeds in the grass around the fruit trees.

f3_program: collection("dinner.pizzas", "pizza", "pizzeria", source("share 2 pizzas"))
observe(at("dinner.pizzas.count", "initial"), 2, "count", source("2 pizzas"))
collection("dinner.pizza_slices", "slice", "dinner.pizzas", source("each pizza is cut into 12 slices"))
observe(at("dinner.pizza_slices.per_pizza.count", "current"), 12, "count", source("12 slices"))
rate_relation(at("dinner.pizza_slices.count", "initial"), at("dinner.pizza_slices.per_pizza.count", "current"), at("dinner.pizzas.count", "initial"), source("each pizza is cut into 12 slices"))
consume("bob_eats_pizza", "bob", at("dinner.pizza_slices.count", "current"), fraction(at("dinner.pizza_slices.per_pizza.count", "current"), 1, 2), source("Bob ate half of a pizza on his own"))
consume("tom_eats_pizza", "tom", at("dinner.pizza_slices.count", "current"), fraction(at("dinner.pizza_slices.per_pizza.count", "current"), 1, 3), source("Tom ate one-third of a pizza"))
consume("sally_eats_pizza", "sally", at("dinner.pizza_slices.count", "current"), fraction(at("dinner.pizza_slices.per_pizza.count", "current"), 1, 6), source("only ate one-sixth of a pizza"))
consume("jerry_eats_pizza", "jerry", at("dinner.pizza_slices.count", "current"), fraction(at("dinner.pizza_slices.per_pizza.count", "current"), 1, 4), source("Jerry ate a quarter of a pizza"))
query("remaining_count", "dinner.pizza_slices", "current")
assumptions: Each stated pizza fraction is a fraction of one 12-slice pizza.

f3_program: collection("lyanna.food_bank.food", "food", "food bank", source("food bank to collect food"))
observe(at("lyanna.food_bank.donations.week_1.amount", "week_1"), 40, "pound", source("In the first week, 40 pounds of food were donated to the food bank by the people of her local town"))

add("week_1_donation", "local_town.people", at("lyanna.food_bank.food.amount", "current"), at("lyanna.food_bank.donations.week_1.amount", "week_1"), source("In the first week, 40 pounds of food were donated to the food bank by the people of her local town"))

multiple(at("lyanna.food_bank.donations.week_2.amount", "week_2"), at("lyanna.food_bank.donations.week_1.amount", "week_1"), 2, source("In the second week, donations were twice as high as the first week"))

add("week_2_donation", "local_town.people", at("lyanna.food_bank.food.amount", "current"), at("lyanna.food_bank.donations.week_2.amount", "week_2"), source("In the second week, donations were twice as high as the first week"))

sum_relation(at("lyanna.food_bank.donated_food.amount", "through_week_2"), at("lyanna.food_bank.donations.week_1.amount", "week_1"), at("lyanna.food_bank.donations.week_2.amount", "week_2"), source("In the first week, 40 pounds of food were donated to the food bank by the people of her local town. In the second week, donations were twice as high as the first week"))

percent_of(at("lyanna.food_bank.distribution.amount", "week_3"), at("lyanna.food_bank.donated_food.amount", "through_week_2"), 70, source("she gave out 70% of the donated food to the homeless in the third week"))

transfer("week_3_distribution", "lyanna", at("lyanna.food_bank.food.amount", "current"), at("local_town.homeless_people.food.amount", "current"), at("lyanna.food_bank.distribution.amount", "week_3"), source("she gave out 70% of the donated food to the homeless in the third week"))

difference_relation(at("lyanna.food_bank.food.remaining.amount", "after_week_3"), at("lyanna.food_bank.donated_food.amount", "through_week_2"), at("lyanna.food_bank.distribution.amount", "week_3"), source("If she gave out 70% of the donated food to the homeless in the third week, calculate the amount of food remaining in the food bank"))
query("value", at("lyanna.food_bank.food.remaining.amount", "after_week_3"))
assumptions: The phrase "the donated food" refers to the combined first- and second-week donations.
